title: Money::format prints negative amounts wrongly
requirement: A customer refund shows up as "EUR -1.-99" instead of "EUR -1.99", and minus five cents shows as "EUR 0.-5" instead of "EUR -0.05". Fix Money::format so a negative amount is printed as "<CUR> -<units>.<two-digit cents>", with a single leading minus sign, for every negative amount, including amounts below one unit. Positive and zero amounts must keep their current format.
